design: Anchor model: full trajectory + scaling laws + milestone timing
mechanism: Schooling–government–market interaction on one system; no portability yet
data_required: GMR/UIS observed GER 1971-2024; completion 1999-2024; jobs panel; events (K12 2013, free SHS 2016, free tertiary 2018; nurse visa 2005-06; BPO)
arms: anchor model vs 3 rivals; event-conditional vs unconditional
estimand: levels/shape, M0-M4 crossings, event breaks, capacity-gated vs law-only comparison, ceiling residual decomposition (upper-sec 75 vs 90; candidate accounts predeclared or UNABLE)
threshold: levels 5/8pp + beat persistence/trend; M0-M4 crossing timing; scaling reported as FAIL (no fitting); capacity-gated beats law-only or EQUIVALENT; no false ceiling universalization (R29); residual reported, not explained away

design: State-push candidate-marker battery (alignment-gated): PH 1987/2013-16/2018, 4Ps; only markers that pass R24 (computable window, predicted sign, gap <=5y) are mechanism tests; PHL candidates currently fail
mechanism: Laws as candidate timing markers only where aligned; PHL state pushes do not align with crossings (1987 -> +31y; K-12 after upper-sec mass; 2018 window negative/confounded), so the anchor's state-push channel must be justified by alignment or abandoned
data_required: Observed completion 1999-2024; DepEd/DPWH school/teacher series (web search); RA 10533 timeline
arms: event vs pre-trend; exposed cohorts vs placebo; income-quartile differential for fee abolition
estimand: break at event date; cohort DiD; income-gradient response
threshold: R24 alignment; capacity level-specific: floor candidates testable, ceiling NOT sufficient (R29); no false upper-sec universalization; proxies labelled; enforcement unmeasured

design: Demand-pull battery (nurse visa 2005-06; BPO regional growth; remittances)
mechanism: Foreign/domestic demand raises expected returns and pulls schooling/field choice
data_required: Published nurse design (simulated-only if no series); BPO/industry regional data; remittances (ECONOMY_SERIES)
arms: field-specific (nursing) vs placebo fields; high- vs low-BPO regions; remittance-rich vs poor

mechanism: Schooling expansion may create jobs (positive) or be absorbed in informality/queue (R13)
arms: education-led vs demand-led vs queue model on same record
threshold: sign: positive would support job creation; ~0/negative = queue; report R13

design: Rival-model comparison on the same record — testable-now: world-society timing, state-building step, demographic contrast, formal-model shapes; design-only: human capital (PSA), signalling/MMI (employer requirement)
mechanism: Rivals scored on crossing years/spacing (A6) and on whether their mechanism implies the observed ordering; laws are candidate markers only (A7)
data_required: Same PHL record/events; cross-country completion panel (on disk); report layer: IBE 2007 + WB 2017 skills table (on disk); BEPER 2019 retrieve public; DATA ASKS: PSA microdata returns/household, Enterprise Surveys credential module (user approval)
arms: Four testable rivals fitted identically + anchor; design-only two listed with data requirements, not modelled
estimand: Milestone ordering/gaps (primary 2017, lower-sec 2024, upper-sec never, tertiary 2024-25) and event breaks; OOS 2014-2024
threshold: Anchor must beat the four testable rivals on ordering/gaps and event breaks; else EQUIVALENT; design-only rivals flagged, no silent drop

design: Transfer test: 1986 compulsory law, 1999 expansion, 2006 fee abolition
mechanism: Portability: CHN 1999 expansion is an aligned candidate (tertiary GER +4.70, t=7.94); CHN 1986 compulsory misses the primary crossing by 27y; carry crossing years as the target, laws as candidate markers (A7)
data_required: UIS/GMR observed; policy dates; national sources (web)
arms: PHL-estimated parameters fixed; only country inputs re-set
threshold: §3 tolerances + timing +/-5y; event breaks predeclared; no behavioural re-fit (R20)

design: Transfer test: 1971/1978 compulsory expansion; 2012 HKDSE context; near-universal timing
mechanism: Portability: HKG 2009 free senior secondary is an aligned candidate (upper-sec NER +9.08, t=5.20); 1971/1978 early pushes predate observable crossings; HKG lower-sec NER crossing is a measure artefact; target = crossing years (A7)
data_required: 1971/1978 policy dates; observed series (no UIS completion; reconstructed timing)
arms: PHL parameters fixed; country inputs re-set; timing regime
threshold: timing +/-5y (+/-3 narrow); left-censored boundary; no level fitting

design: Baseline-data web pull (pre-1999 completion, places/teachers, fee/event dates)
mechanism: Fill anchor gaps from UNESCO/World Bank/national public sources; enables A1-A3
data_required: UIS/World Bank/national public tables; web search with source+vintage; no imputation as observation
threshold: all series observed-labelled, sourced, vintaged; DATA BLOCKED where absent
